title: [For Hire] Unity Developer to Build, Fix or Scale Your Game Systems
description:
I help indie teams, studios, and founders build reliable Unity game systems, backend features, and LiveOps tools without converting the project into tech debt.

Over 8 years of Unity development, I’ve delivered 25+ projects and 80+ milestone-based builds, from gameplay systems and monetization features to backend-connected and LiveOps tools.

What I work on

I develop Unity projects from scratch and help continue, enhance or scale existing game projects.

Popular areas I deal with:

  • Gameplay systems: mechanics, combat, progression, upgrades, tasks, replayability loops
  • Game economy & monetization: currencies, rewards, IAP stores, offers, balancing logic
  • Backend & online features: authentication, cloud saves, leaderboards, friends, chat
  • LiveOps systems: events, cosmetics, offers, and content updates without full store releases
  • Project architecture: clean and reusable systems that are easier to maintain and expand

For big scopes I can bring in trusted developers I already worked with, while staying responsible for architecture, quality and core systems.

Portfolio

  • Backend platform for multiple games under one account
  • Tycoon/hotel simulator systems
  • Puzzle, Mahjong and parking puzzle games
  • Hybrid casual and roguelike projects
  • IAP stores, progression loops, economy systems, and LiveOps tools

YouTube channel (portfolio samples): https://www.youtube.com/@whitearrowgamedev

How I work

  • Development is split into clear 2-week milestones
  • Each milestone has agreed goals, deliverables, timeline, and estimate
  • Every milestone ends with a playable build you can test
  • Milestones are estimated upfront, with pricing calculated at $25/hour

It provides transparency, reduces risks and allows to fine-tune gameplay concept during development process.

Contact

  • DM me here
  • Discord: cliffcalist
  • Email: cliffstersprog@gmail.com

Send me a DM with a short description of your game, what needs to be built or fixed, and your target timeline. I’ll reply with a realistic milestone plan and estimate.
